function_v0.doc:
Register the verification key for a credential circuit. Admin-role only.
A version's VK is immutable once set \xe2\x80\x94 re-registering an existing
(credential_type, version) panics with `VkAlreadySet`; register a new
(higher) version to upgrade. The VK is validated by parsing it before
storage, rejecting malformed keys at set time.
function_v0.name: set_vk

function_v0.doc: Admin-only: upgrade contract to new WASM, emitting an upgrade event.
function_v0.name: upgrade

function_v0.doc: Returns the contract version as an encoded u32.\nEncoding: (major * 1000000) + (minor * 1000) + patch\nExample: 1.2.3 -> 1002003
function_v0.name: version

udt_struct_v0.doc: Payload emitted when the contract is upgraded (new WASM deployed).\nTopics: ("cred_ver", "upgraded")
udt_struct_v0.name: EventContractUpgraded

function_v0.doc:
Assign `address` as the holder of `role`, replacing any previous holder.
Root-admin only. Use this to delegate or rotate a role's key \xe2\x80\x94 e.g. hand
the `admin` role to an operations key, or prepare an `upgrader` /
`pauser` key before such functionality is enabled.
function_v0.name: grant_role

function_v0.doc:
Remove `address` as the holder of `role`. Root-admin only.

The named address must be the current holder (revoking a different
address is a no-op risk, so it is rejected with `RoleHolderMismatch`
instead). A role with no holder is simply unassigned \xe2\x80\x94 no one can act
under it until it is granted again.
function_v0.name: revoke_role

function_v0.doc:
Accept the pending root-admin role. Callable only by the address named
in the most recent `propose_admin`. On success the accepted address
becomes the new `DataKey::Admin` AND inherits every role the outgoing
admin held \xe2\x80\x94 a wholesale governance transfer, so the outgoing root
loses all privileged access exactly as it did before roles existed.
Fine-grained delegation afterwards uses `grant_role` / `revoke_role`.
Emits `("cred_ver", "adm_acc")` with the new admin as the payload (#342).
function_v0.name: accept_admin

function_v0.doc:
Verify an UltraHonk proof for any registered credential type. Looks up
the VK by `(credential_type, vk_version)`. Pass `vk_version = None` to
use the latest registered version automatically.

Returns `true` iff the proof is valid. Returns `false` for malformed
inputs or invalid proofs; panics with `VkNotSet` if no VK has been
registered for this type/version, or with `VersionDeprecated` if the
requested version has been deprecated.
function_v0.name: verify_proof

function_v0.doc: Read the current pending admin proposal, if any (#342).
function_v0.name: pending_admin

function_v0.doc: Propose a new root admin. Root-admin only. Overwrites any existing\npending proposal. Emits `("cred_ver", "adm_prop")` with the proposed\naddress as the payload (#342).
function_v0.name: propose_admin

function_v0.doc:
Admin-only. Permanently removes the VK bytes for a deprecated version.
The safety delay starts when deprecation occurred, not when pruning is
requested. The deprecation marker is retained, preventing reuse.

The minimum delay before pruning is `MAX_PROOF_VALIDITY_SECONDS`
(currently 90 days), which is the on-chain enforcement of the VK
support window defined in SUPPORT_POLICY.md. `prune_version` will
revert with `VkStillReferenceable` until that delay has elapsed.
function_v0.name: prune_version

function_v0.doc:
Admin-role only. Marks a specific `(credential_type, version)` VK as
deprecated. New submissions against a deprecated version are rejected
by `verify_proof` (panics with `VersionDeprecated`), but the VK is not
deleted, so existing cached proofs that were verified against that
version remain readable in ProofRegistry.
function_v0.name: deprecate_version

function_v0.doc: Returns the highest VK version registered for `credential_type`, or\npanics with `VkNotSet` if no VK has been registered for the type yet.
function_v0.name: get_latest_version

function_v0.doc: Cancel a pending admin proposal. Root-admin only. Emits\n`("cred_ver", "adm_canc")` with an empty payload (#342).
function_v0.name: cancel_admin_proposal

function_v0.doc: Returns the timestamp of the last upgrade, or 0 if none has occurred.
function_v0.name: last_upgrade_timestamp

function_v0.doc:
Admin-role only. Refreshes the TTL of the `LatestVersion` pointer AND the VK
blob it resolves to, so that `verify_proof(..., None)` \xe2\x80\x94 the default
submission path \xe2\x80\x94 keeps working in long-lived deployments that register
no new circuit versions. Panics with `VkNotSet` if no VK has been
registered for the credential type yet.

The pointer alone is not enough: if the VK blob at
`Vk(credential_type, version)` expires, `verify_proof` panics with
`VkNotSet` at the blob lookup even though the pointer is still alive.
And because `set_vk` rejects re-registration of an existing version
(`VkAlreadySet`), this refresh is the only way to extend VK blob TTLs
after deployment.
function_v0.name: refresh_latest_version_ttl
